rationale: S-0033-03 proposes a multi-fidelity surrogate-NN prototype to reduce the $41.56 training burn on the recommended t0033 optimiser cell. The t0033 optimiser remains deferred per brainstorm 9 / brainstorm 10. The surrogate-NN cost-reduction idea remains valid but is not on the critical path until the optimiser itself is revived. Reprioritising from high to medium.
